inlines.v: WHINE, verb transitive [Latin] TO express murmurs by a plaintive cry; to moan with a puerile noise; to murmur meanly. They came--with a whining accent craving liberty. Then, if we whine look pale-- WHINE, noun A plaintive tone; the nasal puerile tone of mean complaint; mean or affected complaint.
